newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Accused B.Desh executives win court order.
newsitem.headline: Accused B.Desh executives win court order.

text.p: A Bangladeshi court has halted proceedings against four top executives of the Beximco Group, the country's largest corporate house, who are accused of manipulating share prices, the company's lawyers said on Sunday.

The Dhaka District Court on Saturday passed a "stay order" on further proceedings following a petition challenging the legality of the cases against A.S.F. Rahman, Salman F Rahman, D.H. Khan and A.B. Siddiqur Rahman of Beximco Pharmaceuticals and Shine Pukukur Holding Ltd.

They were among 36 brokers and company executives against whom the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filed cases last month for alleged involvement in price manipulations that triggered upheavals in the share market late last year.
